payload.leagueSummary: NET is the main knife fight right now, and the top end is being dragged around by a couple of dudes who can absolutely ball-strike when the driver behaves. Dan94 and KeithK75 are the cleanest gross scorers in the window, which is a polite way of saying they’re making everyone else look like they learned golf from a YouTube short. BigTime is hanging near the top on steady tee-to-green competence, while the middle and back half of the board starts getting ugly fast: lots of bogeys, not enough birdie pressure, and way too many rounds where the putter is basically a decorative object.
leagueBullets: The league’s front-runners are separating more with ball-striking than with miracle putting; Dan94 and KeithK75 are doing the heavy lifting in gross and that usually spills into NET too.
BigTime is the model of boringly effective golf: plenty of fairways, plenty of greens, not a ton of fireworks, just enough competence to stay annoying.
Below the top tier, the field gets real frisky with bogeys and low GIR rates, which means one bad stretch of contact can turn a round into a slow-motion dumpster fire.
